foodie.title: Seafood Dinner with a View at Simon & Seafort's
foodie.description: Watch the sun linger over Cook Inlet from a window table while working through fresh halibut and a raw bar tower.

foodie.title: Mediterranean-Alaska Fusion at Orso
foodie.description: Pair fresh-caught Alaskan halibut with Mediterranean flair at one of downtown's most polished dinner tables.
foodie.bonus: Let the sommelier pick your wine

foodie.title: King Crab Boil at Inferno Seafood Boil
foodie.description: Crack into a mountain of Alaskan king crab legs dumped straight onto butcher paper in front of you.
foodie.bonus: Eat the whole thing with your hands, no shortcuts

foodie.title: Fresh Alaskan Seafood Dinner at Jens' Restaurant
foodie.description: Sit down for king salmon or halibut prepared with Danish precision at one of Anchorage's most celebrated tables.
foodie.bonus: Ask the server what came off the boat today

foodie.title: Monday Night Salmon Bake at Crow Creek Mine
foodie.description: Eat grilled salmon off a paper plate in a gold rush ghost camp while live acoustic music drifts over the creek.
foodie.bonus: Learn one verse of the musician's set

foodie.title: Wood-Fired Pizza at Moose's Tooth Pub & Pizzeria
foodie.description: Squeeze into Anchorage's busiest pizzeria for a pie topped with reindeer sausage and a pint of house-brewed ale.
foodie.bonus: Order the weirdest topping combo on the menu

foodie.title: Spirits Tasting at Anchorage Distillery
foodie.description: Sample small-batch whiskey, gin, and vodka distilled from Delta Junction barley and glacier-fed water.
foodie.bonus: Ask the bartender which spirit sells out fastest

foodie.title: Halibut Fish and Chips at Humpy's Great Alaskan Alehouse
foodie.description: Dig into a basket of beer-battered halibut fresh off the boat while a local band tunes up in the corner.
foodie.bonus: Pair it with a beer you've never tried

foodie.title: Craft Flight at Midnight Sun Brewing Company
foodie.description: Work through a tasting flight at Anchorage's oldest craft brewery, from crisp pilsner to barrel-aged imperial stout.
foodie.bonus: Rank the flight from lightest to boldest

foodie.title: All-Day Brunch at Snow City Cafe
foodie.description: Load up on sockeye salmon cakes benedict at Anchorage's favorite from-scratch breakfast spot before the wait list fills.
foodie.bonus: Strike up a conversation with whoever's in line with you

foodie.title: Chef's Tasting Menu at Seven Glaciers
foodie.description: Savor a four-course prix fixe of wild game and local seafood while seven named glaciers glow outside the window at 2,300 feet.

adventure.title: Zipline the Girdwood Rainforest Canopy
adventure.description: Rocket through old-growth Sitka spruce on eight ziplines and two rappels strung above the Chugach foothills.
adventure.bonus: Let go of the brake line for one full second

adventure.title: Hike the Historic Crow Pass Trail
adventure.description: Follow the old Iditarod supply route past a glacier basin and hanging waterfalls out of Eagle River Nature Center.
adventure.bonus: Bring bear spray and know how to use it

adventure.title: Guided Aurora Photography Tour
adventure.description: Chase the forecast out of the city lights with a local guide and watch green light ripple across the winter sky.
adventure.bonus: Take a portrait under the lights

adventure.title: Sunrise Kayak on Jewel Lake
adventure.description: Paddle a calm neighborhood lake while morning mist lifts off the water and the city is still asleep.
adventure.bonus: Paddle out before 7am and watch the mist clear

adventure.title: Skate the Groomed Loop at Westchester Lagoon
adventure.description: Lace up and glide across a zamboni-smoothed lagoon with the Chugach skyline as your backdrop.
adventure.bonus: Skate one full lap backward

adventure.title: Stand-Up Paddleboard Eklutna Lake
adventure.description: Balance across turquoise glacial water with jagged Chugach peaks rising straight out of the lake.
adventure.bonus: Paddle to the far shore and back without falling in

adventure.title: Ski or Ride Alyeska Resort
adventure.description: Carve turns down Alaska's only major ski resort, where the tram views stretch from glaciers to the ocean.
adventure.bonus: Take one run you'd normally skip

adventure.title: Winter Dog Sled Ride on the Iditarod Trail
adventure.description: Grip the sled rail as a full husky team launches you silently across snow-covered backcountry near Anchorage.
adventure.bonus: Try mushing a short stretch yourself

adventure.title: Nordic Ski the Kincaid Park Trails
adventure.description: Kick and glide across Olympic-caliber groomed loops winding through spruce forest above Cook Inlet.
adventure.bonus: Try skate-skiing for at least one loop

adventure.title: 26 Glacier Cruise from Whittier
adventure.description: Cruise deep into Prince William Sound aboard a high-speed catamaran as tidewater glaciers calve into the sea around you.
adventure.bonus: Spot a whale before the crew does

adventure.title: Cycle the Tony Knowles Coastal Trail
adventure.description: Pedal 11 miles of paved trail along Cook Inlet with a real shot at spotting moose in the brush.
adventure.bonus: Ride all the way to Kincaid Park and back

adventure.title: Snowshoe the Eagle River Nature Center Trails
adventure.description: Crunch through fresh snow on a quiet forest loop with the Chugach peaks framed in every direction.
adventure.bonus: Break trail through untouched snow for a stretch

adventure.title: Bouldering Session at Alaska Rock Gym
adventure.description: Chalk up and work a bouldering problem on the gym's freestanding 15-foot boulder in Midtown.
adventure.bonus: Try a route two grades above your comfort level

adventure.title: Meet the Dogs at an Iditarod Musher's Kennel
adventure.description: Get pulled down a forest trail by a barking, tail-wagging team of Alaskan huskies trained by real Iditarod racers.
adventure.bonus: Ask a musher for their wildest trail story

adventure.title: Alyeska Aerial Tram to Seven Glaciers Overlook
adventure.description: Ride a glass-walled tram 2,300 feet up Mt. Alyeska and watch seven named glaciers glitter across the Girdwood valley.
adventure.bonus: Find all seven glaciers from the deck

adventure.title: Knik Glacier Flightseeing from Lake Hood
adventure.description: Lift off the world's busiest floatplane base and bank low over an iceberg-choked lake at the face of Knik Glacier.
adventure.bonus: Ask the pilot to point out a moose from the air

adventure.title: Glacier Discovery Train to Spencer Glacier
adventure.description: Roll along Turnagain Arm on the Alaska Railroad and step off at a backcountry whistle stop with glacier views straight ahead.
adventure.bonus: Wave at the engineer from the vestibule

adventure.title: Watch the Bore Tide Roll In at Beluga Point
adventure.description: Stand on a Turnagain Arm bluff as a six-foot wall of tide sweeps in faster than you can outrun it.
adventure.bonus: Check a tide chart and time your arrival exactly

adventure.title: Pan for Gold at Crow Creek Mine
adventure.description: Kneel creekside at a working 1896 gold claim and swirl a pan until real flakes glint in the gravel.
adventure.bonus: Keep every flake you find

adventure.title: Summit Flattop Mountain
adventure.description: Scramble the last rocky pitch of Anchorage's most-climbed peak to a 360-degree view of the Chugach and the inlet below.
adventure.bonus: Sign the summit register

adventure.title: Cast for King Salmon at Ship Creek
adventure.description: Wade into Alaska's most productive urban fishery and battle a wild king salmon blocks from downtown high-rises.
adventure.bonus: Ask a stranger on the bank for their best technique tip

adventure.title: Hot Yoga Class at Studio Hot Yoga
adventure.description: Sweat through a heated flow class in a Jewel Lake studio built for exactly this kind of reset.
adventure.bonus: Hold the final pose an extra ten seconds

adventure.title: Round of Disc Golf at Kincaid Park
adventure.description: Throw all 18 holes of a heavily wooded course where moose sightings are as common as bad drives.
adventure.bonus: Play the whole round with just one disc

adventure.title: Mountain Bike Kincaid Park's Singletrack
adventure.description: Rip through 27 kilometers of forested singletrack built into a coastal bluff on Anchorage's west side.
adventure.bonus: Session the same technical section three times

chill.title: Wander the Alaska Botanical Garden
chill.description: Follow winding paths through 1,100 species of perennials and alpine wildflowers just minutes from downtown.
chill.bonus: Find the one plant you can't identify and look it up

chill.title: Picnic at Earthquake Park
chill.description: Spread a blanket on ground still tumbled from the 1964 quake, with Mt. Susitna framed across the inlet.
chill.bonus: Read the trail markers about the 1964 quake

chill.title: Sunset Walk to Point Woronzof
chill.description: Follow the Coastal Trail out to a bluff where the sun drops behind the Alaska Range over Cook Inlet.
chill.bonus: Watch for beluga whales in the inlet below

chill.title: Watch the Salmon Run at Ship Creek
chill.description: Lean on the railing downtown and watch wild king and silver salmon churn upstream right through the city.
chill.bonus: Count how many salmon you see jump

chill.title: $4 Movie Night at Bear Tooth Theatrepub
chill.description: Sink into a theater seat with a burrito and a pint while a second-run film plays on the big screen.
chill.bonus: Order off the food menu instead of popcorn

chill.title: Village Sites Tour at Alaska Native Heritage Center
chill.description: Walk between life-sized traditional dwellings representing Alaska's Indigenous cultures while dancers perform at the Gathering Place.
chill.bonus: Ask a cultural host a question about their village

chill.title: Browse the Anchorage Market on 3rd Avenue
chill.description: Weave through 200-plus vendor booths of local art, food, and live music filling downtown every weekend.
chill.bonus: Buy something handmade by a local artist

chill.title: Explore Art of the North at the Anchorage Museum
chill.description: Move through galleries of Arctic art, Indigenous artifacts, and hands-on science exhibits under one downtown roof.
chill.bonus: Pick your favorite piece and explain why to a friend

chill.title: Slow Coffee at Kaladi Brothers Coffee
chill.description: Settle into a corner table with a locally roasted pour-over and watch downtown Anchorage wake up.
chill.bonus: Order a drink you've never tried

chill.title: Nature Walk on the Albert Loop Trail
chill.description: Stroll a flat, wooded loop past beaver ponds at Eagle River Nature Center with the Chugach rising all around.
chill.bonus: Spot a beaver lodge along the pond

chill.title: Chase the Aurora from Glen Alps
chill.description: Drive up to the Chugach overlook after dark and wait for green light to ripple silently across the sky above the city.
chill.bonus: Turn off your phone flashlight and let your eyes adjust

chill.title: Public Skate at Ben Boeke Ice Arena
chill.description: Glide around the rink at Anchorage's longtime indoor arena, no ice-thickness reports required.
chill.bonus: Try skating backward for one full lap

social.title: Target Practice at Frosted Axe Throwing
social.description: Grip a hatchet, wind up, and stick a bullseye across ten digital-scored lanes with friends cheering you on.
social.bonus: Try throwing with your non-dominant hand

social.title: Sunset Rooftop Drinks at 49th State Brewing
social.description: Post up on the rooftop patio with a cold one as the Alaska Range catches the evening light over Cook Inlet.
social.bonus: Toast to whoever's visiting Alaska for the first time

social.title: Xtreme Glow Bowling at Jewel Lake Bowl
social.description: Bowl under blacklights and a live DJ as special effects take over the lanes for the night.
social.bonus: Bet a round of sodas on the next game

social.title: Alaska Craft Brew and Barley Wine Festival
social.description: Sample 250-plus regional beers, ciders, and meads under one roof at Anchorage's biggest winter beer bash.
social.bonus: Vote for your favorite in the People's Choice

social.title: Bar-Hop 4th Avenue Starting at Avenue Bar
social.description: Kick off a downtown crawl with craft cocktails and DJs before working your way down 4th Avenue's bar row.
social.bonus: Talk to a stranger at the bar

social.title: Crack the Code at Alaska Escape Rooms
social.description: Race the clock with your crew to solve puzzles and bust out of a locked downtown room.
social.bonus: Let the newest member of your group make the final call

social.title: Comedy Up North Show at The Peanut Farm
social.description: Grab wings and a beer at Alaska's biggest sports bar while touring comedians work the room.
social.bonus: Sit in the front two rows

social.title: First Friday Art Walk Downtown
social.description: Hop between 20-plus downtown galleries for opening receptions, live music, and free admission to the Anchorage Museum.
social.bonus: Talk to an artist about one of their pieces

social.title: Live Local Music at Humpy's Great Alaskan Alehouse
social.description: Grab a table near the stage as a local band plays free and the craft beer list keeps rotating.
social.bonus: Request a song from the band

social.title: Karaoke Night at Chilkoot Charlie's
social.description: Grab the mic inside a sprawling maze of theme bars where Spenard's legendary nightlife never sits still.
social.bonus: Sing a song you've never attempted before

social.title: Dive Into Pioneer Bar's 4th Avenue Scene
social.description: Pull up a stool at one of downtown's oldest dive bars, where the regulars know everyone by name.
social.bonus: Ask the bartender for the bar's best story

social.title: Pint Flight and Food Truck Night at Cynosure Brewing
social.description: Work through a lineup of lagers and Belgian-style ales in a SoMiTo taproom lined with local art.
social.bonus: Ask the bartender for their personal favorite pour
